parameters.fit: crispri.logistic_fit, lam 1e-3, 25 rounds, on the covered training pairs

parameters.heldout_scoring: frozen weights, per cell type, covered pairs only, unweighted
parameters.estimator: crispri.average_precision (step-wise, unweighted); the published-benchmark estimator crispri.benchmark_auprc belongs to crispri_published_v2, not to this result
parameters.interval_provenance: every interval states clusters, draws_requested, draws_dropped, met_minimum and enough_clusters (crispri._interval_provenance)
parameters.gain_where_unavailable: the deletion feature is not available in this stratum, so no deletion gain is measured here: the difference between the two models would be an artefact of the model form, not a measurement
parameters.gain_where_no_pairs: the stratum holds no pair, so there is no population to measure a deletion gain on

exclusions: rebuilt under a new name on 2026-10-02: 2000 chromosome resamples per interval in place of 200, each interval stating the clusters and draws it rests on, no interval at all below 10 clusters, and no deletion gain where a stratum carries no deletion value; the committed result at data/results/crispri_benchmark.json (date 2026-09-22) is kept unchanged beside this one
a pair no deleted element overlaps is not scored in any arm here: every arm is the covered pairs of its stratum, and the coverage is reported beside it

held-out HCT116, Jurkat and WTC11 are refused outright rather than scored with deletion features of zero: the sweep kept four cell lines and these three carry no deletion value, so the deletion feature is not available in this stratum, so no deletion gain is measured here: the difference between the two models would be an artefact of the model form, not a measurement
an interval resting on fewer than 10 chromosomes is not reported at all; the point estimate is, because it does not depend on the resampling, and no replacement interval is written by hand
per-cell held-out blocks for a cell with no regulated pair are omitted

model_dependencies.unpinned: unpinned: no model version was requested. dna_client.create(api_key) and create(api_key, timeout=300) leave model_version None, so every ScoreVariantRequest carried an empty model_version and the server chose. No response message carries a model version (model_version is a request field only in dna_model_service.proto) and no cache file, result or job log records one, so which model answered cannot be established from disk
